facts.en: Completed a general retail certificate at Fictional Hazelreed College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构榛苇学院完成通用零售证书课程。

facts.en: Paid hardware counter assistant at Fictional Brickfinch Stores from 2019-02 to 2022-10.
facts.zh: 2019-02 至 2022-10 在虚构砖雀商店任有薪五金柜台助理。

facts.en: In that role, located supplier-coded fasteners and recorded customer collections against order numbers.
facts.zh: 在该岗位查找带供应商代码的紧固件，并按订单编号记录客户取货。

facts.en: Paid sales and stock assistant at Fictional Honeyarch Supplies from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构蜜拱用品店任有薪销售与库存助理。

facts.en: Picked empty hive boxes, protective clothing and packaged frame parts from the shop’s approved product catalogue.
facts.zh: 依据商店获批产品目录拣选空蜂箱、防护服及包装好的巢框部件。

facts.en: Compared part codes and listed dimensions when customers asked whether supplied components matched.
facts.zh: 客户询问所售组件是否匹配时，比较零件代码及所列尺寸。

facts.en: Passed bee-health and treatment questions to the shop’s designated specialist rather than selecting treatments.
facts.zh: 将蜜蜂健康及治疗方法问题转交商店指定专员，而非选择治疗方案。

facts.en: Counted sealed component packs against supplier delivery notes and kept opened display packs separately.
facts.zh: 依据供应商送货单清点密封组件包，并将已打开的展示包分开存放。

facts.en: Helped recount a frame-parts display in 2025-08.
facts.zh: 2025-08 协助重新清点巢框部件展示区。

facts.en: The recount found 18 sealed packs, each labeled as containing parts for 10 frames, plus 6 loose frame components.
facts.zh: 重新盘点发现 18 个密封包，每包标签标明内含可组装 10 个巢框的部件，另有 6 个散装巢框组件。

facts.en: The sealed packs were not opened during that recount; the loose components were not recorded as complete frames.
facts.zh: 该次盘点未打开密封包；散装组件未被记录为完整巢框。

facts.en: Prepared parcel labels, recorded dispatch references and told customers when reserved orders were ready.
facts.zh: 准备包裹标签、记录发货编号，并在预留订单可取时通知客户。

facts.en: Processed sales through the till and referred refund exceptions to the shop manager.
facts.zh: 通过收银系统处理销售，并将退款异常转交店长。

facts.en: Uses supplier catalogues, stock-code lookups, a till and parcel-label software.
facts.zh: 使用供应商目录、库存代码查询、收银系统及包裹标签软件。

facts.en: Attended a 2-session introductory beekeeping-products course at Fictional Cloverlamp Centre in 2024; the sessions used empty display equipment and photographs.
facts.zh: 2024 年在虚构三叶草灯中心参加一门共 2 节课的养蜂产品入门课程；课程使用空展示设备及照片。

facts.en: During an in-store demonstration in 2025-03, laid out labeled wooden box parts while the supplier representative assembled the demonstration hive.
facts.zh: 2025-03 店内演示中摆放有标签的木箱部件，展示蜂箱由供应商代表组装。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Oakbutton Repair Circle from 2021-04 to 2022-03, sorting donated screws and labeling hand-tool storage.
facts.zh: 2021-04 至 2022-03 在虚构橡纽修理社做志愿者，整理捐赠螺丝并标记手工具存放位置。

facts.en: Made a personal cardboard model of a garden shed in 2022 from an original sketch.
facts.zh: 2022 年依据原创素描制作个人花园棚纸板模型。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching patterned insect wings from photographs.
facts.zh: 爱好根据照片描绘有图案的昆虫翅膀。

facts.en: The supplied records contain no live-bee husbandry, pesticide application or independently led hive-assembly demonstration.
facts.zh: 所提供记录不含活蜂饲养、施用农药或独立主持蜂箱组装演示的经历。
